latest_release.name: HMM frozen model v1
latest_release.body:
Portable frozen HMM router artifact for the companion policy sidecar.

- Model: `hmm-router-frozen-v1`
- Embedding contract: `google/gemini-embedding-2`, 3072 dimensions
- SHA-256: `b326bda644aac86831bae47d0b69de008046f62324a4b93a1eba702581c174df`
- Runtime data only: no Python pickle, training rows, prompts, training provenance, or WorkWeave registry dependency

This prerelease is intended for the self-hostable HMM sidecar PR. The router remains on cluster routing unless HMM is explicitly configured.
